channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jalen Duren | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jalen Duren from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: John Collins on Jalen Duren
item.description:
John Collins on his fit with Jalen Duren:

“With our athleticism, our ability to dominate the paint, I feel like it’s going to be fun to play with JD. Especially with his vision, I feel like I have some underrated vision. … Always happy to have another good big fella.”

John Collins on Jalen Duren, Oct 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“It is officially over. The Pistons and Jalen Duren have agreed to a five-year, $200 million fully guaranteed contract to return to the Detroit Pistons. There's no options, there's no bonuses included in the deal. Number one, congrats to the young fella, Jalen Duren, getting his bag,putting himself in a position to have him and his family set for the rest of his life. Always love seeing guys get paid. So shout out to the young fella. I've watched his growth over the years from coming into the league and being a physical specimen that didn't really know how to play physical and didn't really know how to use his weight.”

Draymond Green on Jalen Duren, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jalen Duren
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff on Jalen Duren:

“It is negotiation, it is business, but there has never been any bitterness between the group and how we feel about him and I know how he feels about us.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jalen Duren, Oct 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Pistons’ head coach J.B. Bickerstaff on Jalen Duren’s contract dispute:

“I expect JD to be here. I haven't had a doubt in my mind that he was going to come back, no matter what it looks like.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jalen Duren, Oct 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony:

“If I'm Detroit, I'm paying (Jalen Duren).22 years old. We just come off a 60 win season, regardless of what happened in the playoffs. I'm 22, I'm going to get better. I have to get better. So if I get better, this team gets better. Let's assume Cade is going to get better. Let's assume Thompson is going to get better. Let's assume Jalen is going to get better. So now you have this core that you are going to have for the next four, five years. I'd rather go compete with that core and build around that than let this man leave.”

Carmelo Anthony on Jalen Duren, Sep 30, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren being his first public negotiation:

“It’s the first time I’ve had to handle it here. I was in New Orleans for five years with a certain player that wasn’t easy to deal with... we can control what we can control, and that’s how we operate.”

Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren:

“Regardless of what his decision is, what we can control is the way that we welcome him in when he makes that decision. He will be a big part of the team regardless of what decision he makes… and we will get the best version of him. That’s what we can control”

Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Marc Spears on Scott Perry, Jalen Duren
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Marc Spears on Jalen Duren and Sacramento:

“Scott Perry has a relationship with Jalen Duren dating to when he was trying to get the Knicks to draft him which they did, but they traded him to the Pistons... Duren likes Scott Perry a lot, he likes Sacramento a lot, but the Pistons, they're focused on bringing him back, they have some optimism, but it's complicated. I just hear that Jalen, it's not about money right now. He feels disrespected...there's a black cloud going into camp...they gotta try to fix it, and I don't know if they can in time”

Marc Spears on Scott Perry, Jalen Duren, Sep 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Stewart said he believes Jalen Duren should be rewarded.

“It’s tricky, but [Duren] proved he’s worth what he’s asking for to the organization, if you ask me,”

Isaiah Stewart on Jalen Duren, Aug 9, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Langdon on Duren's postseason:

“I think defenses took some things away from him and that's the biggest thing ... I think he would say I didn’t play the basketball I would’ve liked to have played. Sometimes that happens in the league with young players.”

Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren, May 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Detroit Pistons President Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren:

“JD had a fantastic season. All-Star. One of the biggest contributors to us being a No. 1 seed… We look forward to coming together with his representation, getting a deal done, and for him continuing to be a Piston.”

Trajan Langdon on Jalen Duren, May 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Kenny Atkinson on Jalen Duren:

“I don’t know, I’d have to look at the stats, but he’s probably the strongest player in the league. I think every center in this league has issues with his strength and his ability to kind of bully you.”

Kenny Atkinson on Jalen Duren, May 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Robinson:

“How we started last series was not up to our standard. I know (Duren) was discouraged about how he came out in that series. I give him credit for maintaining the consistency of the process, and that series was a microcosm of how effective he can be when he stays at it”

Duncan Robinson on Jalen Duren, May 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Isaiah Stewart, Cade Cunningham, Jalen Duren
item.description:
said Thomas in a one-on-one interview with R.org.

“They have know how and what I mean by know how, they know how to win. Cade Cunningham is possibly MVP of the league. They got (Jalen) Duren, who’s an All Star. They got (Isaiah) Stewart, who could be the defensive player of the year also. They’re covered in every area they got. They got great coaching.”

Isiah Thomas on Isaiah Stewart, Cade Cunningham, Jalen Duren, Feb 17, 2026. Source: R.Org Sports.

item.title: Ausar Thompson on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Ausar Thompson:

“Jalen Duren is an All-Star. Jalen is playing aggressively. Honestly, there’s not a big that really wants to mess with him right now. The one that’s close are the two backups on our team. That’sit.”

Ausar Thompson on Jalen Duren, Dec 31, 2025. Source: Essentially Sports.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Stewart on Duren:

“I think he’s seeing that no one wants to stay in front of his big body… it shows how skilled his and I’m excited for the future for him because as he gets older, the game will continue to slow down.”

Isaiah Stewart on Jalen Duren, Nov 17, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Monty Williams on James Wiseman, Jalen Duren
item.description:
Monty Williams on Jalen Duren/James Wiseman:

“You could have a situation where there's tension, those guys work together every day. They compete against each other. At times, they get physical & it's competitive... I think they have an appreciation for what Wise has been through.”

Monty Williams on James Wiseman, Jalen Duren, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Monty on the explanation for the missed call on Duren:

“He missed it. This is one of those times I can be somewhat gracious to the refs. That, to me, is what the game is about. It's OK to admit you're wrong, and he did ... he acknowledged that he missed it.”

Monty Williams on Jalen Duren, Feb 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Monty on Duren’s improving face-up game:

“I think he’s a guy that has more levels to his game than he’s shown. He’s more than a lob threat or finisher around the basket. He can do some stuff with that ball that’s unique for a guy his size. And we’re encouraging him to do it.”

Monty Williams on Jalen Duren, Jan 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jalen Duren
item.description:
James Edwards III:Monty Williams on Duren:

“He’s just been able to do a bit more on the floor. He’s playing 3-on-3 now. We expect him to be back soon.”

Monty Williams on Jalen Duren, Nov 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jalen Duren
item.description:
James Edwards III:Williams on Duren's growth defensively:

“I know we work at it. He's in the lab with MB and all of the bigs talking about how they can impact the game with physicality and activity.”

Monty Williams on Jalen Duren, Oct 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Monty Williams on why he believes Jalen Duren is the #Pistons’ starting center:

“He has combinations of certain skillsets that a lot of bigs don’t have. That allowed for me to make that decision.”

Monty Williams on Jalen Duren, Oct 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Troy Weaver on Jalen Duren:

“That’s one guy I won’t ever put a ceiling on. As you keep watching him, you just see different things. Coach said early that he won’t be with the Cruise, he’ll be with us. He’s a very smart young man and has tremendous gifts.”

Troy Weaver on Jalen Duren, Apr 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jalen Duren
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Jalen Duren:

“He turned his ankle pretty good. He just couldn't move laterally. I applaud him for trying,he wanted to trade. We didn't want to risk further injury.”

Dwane Casey on Jalen Duren, Feb 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Robert Williams on Jalen Duren
item.description:
Robert Williams on playing against young bigs like Jalen Duren:

“I hate playing against a player like me. It's annoying, man. Rebounding all day, always crashing, it's annoying. You've got to box out every time. What is he? 19? He's doing it young.”

Robert Williams on Jalen Duren, Feb 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Zach Lowe.RealGM on Deandre Ayton, Jalen Duren
item.description:
The Detroit Pistons were linked to a potential pursuit of Deandre Ayton this offseason, but the availability of Jalen Duren at the draft is believed to have led them to change direction.

“The Ayton thing, I think they were going to be the Ayton offer sheet team until Jalen Duren fell to them at 13,”

Zach Lowe.RealGM on Deandre Ayton, Jalen Duren, Oct 12, 2022. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jalen Duren, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
#PistonsTroy Weaver on the draft:

“We had a list of seven guys that we liked, and (Jaden Ivey and Jalen Duren) were at the top of that list.”

Troy Weaver on Jalen Duren, Jaden Ivey, Jun 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Al Horford, Robert Williams, Jalen Duren
item.description:
Asked Weaver how Duren fits with Isaiah Stewart:

“They’re different. (Duren) is bigger. His presence is more pronounced. Isaiah has shown to be able to shoot the 3 more. They can play together. Horford and Robert Williams played together … I don’t see it as a challenge.”

Isaiah Stewart on Al Horford, Robert Williams, Jalen Duren, Jun 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.
